attribution: Spanish vocabulary level data is based in part on ELELex, a CEFR-graded lexical resource developed as part of the CEFRLex project at UCLouvain/CENTAL.

levelPolicy.c2Policy: not-available; no entries are synthesized from the C1 tail
levelPolicy.assignmentRule: Aggregate nb_doc independently at each CEFR level across all ELELex rows for a normalized lemma/POS. Mark the entry attested and assign the first level whose aggregate reaches the document threshold. Otherwise mark it unattested and assign no level.
levelPolicy.duplicateResolution: When multiple ELELex rows normalize to the same lemma and mapped POS, aggregate their per-level document counts before applying the same threshold rule; preserve every source row.

sequencingPolicy.role: Ordering only; this never changes an ELELex CEFR level assignment.
sequencingPolicy.primary: Descending ELELex document count at the entry assigned level.
sequencingPolicy.limitation: ELELex document counts are an exposure-breadth sequencing signal, not calibrated CEFR sub-bands or a general corpus-frequency ranking.

knownDivergences.scope: Blinded 200-entry AI cross-review of the immutable 1,707-entry A1 learner-content run.
knownDivergences.interpretation: The level findings are a known divergence between ELELex document-count level semantics and uncalibrated model pedagogical intuition. ELELex remains authoritative; no level assignment is changed.
knownDivergences.resolution: Handle breadth through deterministic within-level ordering, not re-leveling or A1 sub-bands.

knownDivergences.scope: Blinded 200-entry AI cross-review of the immutable 1,847-entry A2 learner-content run.
knownDivergences.interpretation: This is an AI cross-review disagreement rate, not a measured error rate. ELELex remains authoritative for A2 placement; no level assignment is changed. Sense, definition, and example findings remain explicit QA findings for owner adjudication.
knownDivergences.resolution: Preserve the frozen A2 catalog membership and level assignments; keep the material findings separate from level disagreement.

knownDivergences.scope: Cross-level characterization of blinded gpt-6-astra pedagogical level disagreements. These are AI disagreement rates, not measured error rates or human review.
knownDivergences.characterization: The ELELex first-level-reaching-two-documents bands fit model pedagogical intuition best in the middle levels. The A1 band is too broad relative to that model intuition. C1 is directionally under-advanced: the model predominantly judges its disputed entries easier than C1, reflecting first reliable corpus attestation and rarity rather than intrinsic learning difficulty.
knownDivergences.sourceLimitation: This documents the limits of ELELex document-count semantics; it is not a learner-content defect and does not supersede the licensed source.
knownDivergences.resolution: No level assignment was changed. C1 remains separate from B2. Deterministic descending document-count ordering continues to surface the best-attested entries first within every unchanged level.

futureQualityTargeting.observation: Material-definition disagreements clustered in concrete modern everyday vocabulary, especially food, clothing, sport, and leisure; seven named cases were sushi, camiseta, pollo, bañador, partido, senderismo, and cava.
futureQualityTargeting.action: For A2-C1, supplement broad sampling with deterministic targeted QA in these domains instead of relying on a purely random sample.
futureQualityTargeting.limitation: This is a targeting signal from 14 AI-flagged A1 definitions, not a measured domain error rate.

a2Result.classifier: Deterministic selected-WordNet-synset hypernym ancestry; no model classification.

strictNonCorrespondence.selectionWarning: This is a deliberately targeted cohort, not a probability sample or a level-wide quality rate.

likeForLikeA1.comparison: A2 is 7.35 percentage points and 5.00 times higher than A1 in the same deterministic food/clothing/sport/leisure cohort. These targeted rates describe the cohorts and are not level-wide quality estimates.

minorityPosRisk.rule: Using unrounded ELELex total_freq@total, flag each single-word catalog entry when its normalized lemma/POS source pair holds less than 50% of the supported-POS frequency for that source lemma; expand a flagged normalized display lemma/POS to every immutable generated catalog entry.

incidence.normalizationDifference: The sole 257/258 difference is the two independently generated A1 adverb entries from ELELex solo row 12614 and sólo row 12904 after the approved sólo → solo display normalization.

externalReference.interpretation: A2 is 9.77 percentage points and 2.23 times higher than A1 in this targeted risk cohort. Cohort findings are excluded from probability-sample denominators.

aiCrossReview.label: Targeted AI cross-review disagreement rate; not a measured error rate and not human or native-speaker review.

sharedSlovakHintGate.decision: Retain the approved threshold for A2-C1 and report every flagged outcome as an override, an owner-accepted shared hint, or needsReview; do not re-tune it from A1 outcomes.
sharedSlovakHintGate.knownFalsePositivePattern: The gate measures divergence between Spanish definitions, while the production question is divergence in Slovak lexicalization. Different Spanish definitions can legitimately share one Slovak hint, as carro and coche both map to auto.
sharedSlovakHintGate.scaleExpectation: Expect proportionally more false positives at later levels and report them without presenting the flag rate as a translation defect rate.

productionReviewPolicy.spanishContentStandard: Automated external-reference QA plus an independent AI cross-review plus explicit owner risk acceptance.
productionReviewPolicy.requiredDisclosure: Definitions are generated and automatically verified against reference sources. They have not been reviewed by native speakers.
productionReviewPolicy.claimRestriction: No product, manifest, report, or attribution copy may describe the Spanish content as native-reviewed or human-reviewed.

slovakHintStandard.A1: 100% native-Slovak owner review across all production concepts.
slovakHintStandard.A2ThroughC1: A reproducible probability sample per level, plus separately reported targeted findings excluded from the probability denominator.
slovakHintStandard.escalation: If either probability-sample bound is crossed, expand the sample or require 100% owner review for that level.
slovakHintStandard.baseline: The Slovak owner-disagreement baseline comes from the full A1 owner review and remains pending until those verdicts are complete; A1's 3.33% Spanish external-reference rate is a different metric.
slovakHintStandard.productCopy: A1 Slovak hints reviewed by a native speaker; A2-C1 sampled.

productionReviewPolicy.distributionBlocker: Do not compile or bundle any distributable Spanish course artifact until the unresolved ELELex ShareAlike position is cleared.

courseFilters.attestation: Require at least 2 ELELex documents at one published level.
courseFilters.lexicalTermShape: Require at least two Unicode letters and allow only letters, combining marks, apostrophes, spaces, and hyphens.
courseFilters.properNames: Exclude entries with any source-native FreeLing NP0 or NP* tag plus the six pinned OMW/WordNet-backed person/place-name audit exclusions.
courseFilters.multiwordExpressions: Include attested multiword lexical units unless another course filter excludes them.
courseFilters.multiPosEntries: No filter. Each frozen lemma/POS entry is evaluated independently.

regionalVariantPolicy.interimBehavior: Keep regional variants as independent course entries with their ELELex-derived levels and no structural linkage.

senseGrouping.evidence: Group entries only when their selected OMW senses resolve to the same WordNet synset/ILI.
senseGrouping.learningBehavior: Teach a shared selected-sense concept once and expose every member form for recognition and search.

regionalLabelling.primaryForm: Select a locale-preferred primary form at presentation time only after regional evidence is licensed.

regionalVariantPolicy.invariants: Regional handling must not change ELELex membership or CEFR levels.

headwordOrthography.policy: Apply approved modern display spellings after the source-form OMW join. Preserve stable membership IDs, source forms, source rows, and all source senses.

deferredVariantPresentation.releaseBehavior: Keep current identities and learner presentation unchanged; resolve variant grouping in later orthographic-and-morphological-variant work.
Keep current identities and learner presentation unchanged; resolve variant grouping in later orthographic-and-morphological-variant work.

deferredVariantPresentation.lexicalInterpretation: This is a grammar and presentation relationship, not a second lexical concept.
deferredVariantPresentation.releaseBehavior: Keep current identities and learner presentation unchanged; include this pair in the later orthographic-and-morphological-variant sweep.

sources.commercialPermission: Written permission supersedes the NonCommercial restriction for the authorized Wordfold uses.
sources.shareAlikeStatus: The permission does not address ShareAlike; clarification is pending.
sources.attribution: Spanish vocabulary level data is based in part on ELELex, a CEFR-graded lexical resource developed as part of the CEFRLex project at UCLouvain/CENTAL.
Multilingual Central Repository 3.0 (release 2016), González-Agirre, Laparra and Rigau (2012), packaged by Open Multilingual Wordnet 2.0.

transformations: Replace ELELex underscores with spaces, normalize lemmas with NFKC, collapse whitespace, and lowercase with the Spanish locale.
Map only ELELex-published FreeLing adjective, noun, adverb, and verb tags to WordNet-compatible parts of speech; same-category composite tags are accepted.
Join on normalized lemma plus compatible OMW Spanish part of speech and require at least one OMW sense.
Apply approved modern headword spellings only after the source-form OMW join; retain the original normalized source term and every OMW sense alias.
Aggregate ELELex per-level document counts across duplicate lemma/POS rows; mark entries attested and assign the first level whose aggregate reaches 2 documents.
Retain unattested entries in the frozen membership with a null level and exclude them from course and generation inputs; do not apply a fallback level.
Flag normalized terms with fewer than two Unicode letters or characters outside letters, combining marks, apostrophes, spaces, and hyphens, retaining them frozen but excluding them from the course.
Exclude source-native FreeLing NP0 and NP* proper-name entries and six audited person/place-name misses from the course while retaining them frozen.
Include source-backed multiword lexical units under the same attestation and course filters as single words.
Apply no frequency, size, or level-distribution cutoff.
